reddit.title: Explore the New Conquest Campaign in Provincia!
reddit.body: We're excited to share our latest update on the Conquest campaign in Provincia! Dive into Tutorial 2, where you will navigate a constrained home basin and five adjacent territories. Each territory offers unique rewards and challenges, with fog of war lifting only as you progress. Ready to expand your colony? Check out the details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/five-territories-beyond-the-basin?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=five-territories-beyond-the-basin

embed.description: Learn about the new Conquest campaign and how to expand your colony across five unique territories. Each territory offers specific rewards and requires strategic planning to conquer.

steam.title: New Conquest Campaign in Provincia!
steam.body: We're thrilled to announce the launch of our Conquest campaign in Provincia! In Tutorial 2, you'll face the challenge of conquering five territories beyond your home basin. Each territory presents unique opportunities and requires strategic battles to unlock. Want to learn more? Visit our devtalk for full details: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/five-territories-beyond-the-basin?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=five-territories-beyond-the-basin
